proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I asked to see the autoclave log before I sat down, half joking. She pulled the binder, showed me last week's spore test and opened my needles in front of me. Booked my second piece right there.
reviews.name: Tamika J.

reviews.text: Helix and forward helix. They named the titanium grade, showed me the threadless ends, and texted at week six to come back for the downsize. No bumps this time around.
reviews.name: Erin O.

reviews.text: The price on the website matched the price in the chair. Three hours at the listed hourly rate, minus the deposit I paid at the consult. No surprises.
reviews.name: Vince D.

reviews.text: Swapped the cheap mall studs I'd worn for years for titanium flat backs. Ten minutes, and my ears finally stopped itching.
reviews.name: Nadine K.

reviews.text: My cover-up took two sittings, which is what the consult sheet said. The old barbed-wire band is now a dark peony wreath and you cannot find the wire anywhere.
reviews.name: Joel M.

reviews.text: I came in with a tiny fine-line idea that was honestly too small. Desmond explained why, sized it up a little, and it still reads clean a year later.
reviews.name: Aisha F.

reviews.text: Came back for a touch-up inside the 90-day window. No charge, no back and forth over scheduling, in and out in about twenty minutes.
reviews.name: Grace H.

proof.guarantee: A touch-up on us within 90 days, and a free jewelry downsize for every piercing we do.
